content:
Chapter 33 Playing

After arranging those scribes, Zhong Yu didn't take care of them, but rested well in the territory.

In a few days, a month will come, and then you can reap a wave of luck points.

With this batch of luck points, you can start your own plan, and you can also prepare for a new round of expansion due to the arrival of the luck points.

As for what to exchange for this batch of luck points, Zhong Yu already had a plan in mind. Now that I have a lack of population, if I can exchange it with luck points, I can only exchange it for 1,000 people.

If you recruit strong men and train soldiers, you can only recruit 200 of them, which is far from enough for your next expansion.

Then use these 100 luck points, another most basic exile camp, just like the exile camp last time, a total of 1800 people were sent out, which greatly expanded their strength.

And he also recruited young and strong from it, trained 300 recruits, and now those 300 recruits have greatly helped him. Guarding the territory, following the expedition, requires those recruits in every aspect.

Let's just say that the 2,700 barbarians are now suppressed by the 300 recruits.

Without them, just relying on their 100 guards, no matter how strong they are, there are not so many people to take care of them separately.

Sooner or later, those prisoners will find a loophole and take the opportunity to escape, because they can't control so many people.

When the news leaks out, it will be a bloody, continuous battle. Because of this war, I will also consume a lot of energy to deal with it, slowing down the pace of my development.

In this way, Zhong Yu, who has nothing to do, cultivates in his own mansion every day, and calms his mind that is constantly fluctuating because he has reached this other world.

Since coming to this world, I have been calculating and worrying all the time. I am afraid that the next moment, those powerful barbarians, or some unknown monsters, will run to my territory.

Kill yourself with no strength and preparation. It's like crushing an ant. Now that I have finally gained some strength and a little self-protection, I can relax, how can I not cherish it?

Occasionally, Zhong Yu will also wander around the territory, take a good look at the local customs of the people in his territory, and inspect how the people in his territory live? See how they belong to the field?

After some investigation and practical experience, I found that the lives of most of the residents are still good, and they are quite satisfied with the current situation.

It is the more frequent wars that fill their hearts with a sense of insecurity, and their hearts are filled with great fear, fearing that they will lose their lives at any time because of something.

This is a great hidden danger, but Zhong Yu himself has no good solution, because his situation is also relatively difficult.

There is still more than half a year, and the annual meeting of the Eddra Tribal Alliance is about to start. The time is pressing, and I must seize all the time, work hard to expand my strength, and strive to have the defense against the Eddra Alliance before the annual meeting starts. offensive strength.

That's why I chose to use the luck points to exchange for the civilians, instead of directly exchanging the population. I just wanted to open up some people and recruit more soldiers from them.

Although the territorial people who came out of the exile camps have low loyalty to him, Zhong Yu believes that there are barbarians around him who are different from his own skin color and are still in the era of primitive society and tribes, and even farther away, they are full of savages. Dangerous monsters.

And he is a refugee who lacks enough weapons and food, and has no self-protection power. I believe they will wisely choose to stay by the side of the lord who has the most powerful force, and use their lives to be loyal to themselves and obey their own. Every command to gain its own shelter.

And you can also let them have a good residence, their own fertile land, and a stable family. These are the reasons and reasons for them to dedicate their loyalty to themselves.

In this way, a territory full of crises and striving for progress, constantly expanding in order to obtain sufficient resources for development, was born.

As long as you induce them well, let those refugees understand that the reason for them to join the army and expand their territories is to build a country that is safe enough, rich enough, and strong enough.

In this way, they can protect their families, and the constant wars and sufficient military exploits can also enable them to obtain a higher social status, a better security environment, and more wealth, then they will fully support themselves. .

Just like the Qin state in ancient China, the whole country was living in hardships. Many people did not have a perfect piece of clothing, and the poor could not even afford to eat, so they could only dig wild vegetables everywhere.

Surrounded by prairie tribes in nomadic civilization, and farther away, there are vassal states that are eyeing him, always wanting to annex Qin.

But even under such circumstances, the Qin state, which could be destroyed at any time, was changed because of the arrival of one person, Shang Yang.

He made all the Qin people at the bottom of the society understand that fighting is not all for the monarch, but also for himself.

Victory in the war can allow you to gain more land, more slaves, more wealth, and most importantly, improve your social status.

Let yourself be able to become an aristocrat who was unattainable in the past. For thousands of years, the tradition that untouchables could not become nobles broke.

All the people of the Qin country went crazy because of this reason, and released a beast from the depths of their hearts, and the world has been plagued by disasters since then.

When I heard the war, I rejoiced, worked hard on the battlefield, worked hard to move forward, and constantly killed any enemy in front of my eyes, giving up my life and forgetting death.

It is because they understand that this is for themselves, not for the country. Through this opportunity, I can continue to climb up and become a decision maker. In the past, he had to kneel on the ground and could only look at the nobles with envious eyes from a distance. I also have the opportunity to become a noble, and this is the reason why the Qin Kingdom unified the six countries!

Therefore, the human heart is a very wonderful thing, as long as you can grasp the degree of it, you can control it. Make people's hearts go in the direction they want, and become the sharpest sword in their hands, invincible and unstoppable.

Everyone is striving for the opportunity to climb up. As long as he can find it, he will try his best to seize it.

Especially those who used to be at the bottom of society, the most despised, and the most insecure. The importance of this kind of opportunity is beyond anyone's understanding.

And these refugees are precisely those who are at the bottom and the most insecure, and they will have the opportunity to make them feel at ease to serve themselves.

Constantly sacrifice their lives for themselves, use their blood to expand their territory; use their bones to make their most immortal throne; let their families pay taxes for their country, Conquer the corvée, build upon this great framework, and contribute every bit of their strength.

This is what every high-ranking person must know, and it is also the xinxing that every high-ranking person must have. Fooling the people ignoring the people, this is where all the people can be fooled.

They take away most of the benefits that they have exchanged for their lives, and use the soup left over from their own consumption to make them work harder for themselves.

That's the injustice of society, but those people have to thank themselves. Because, I at least give them a chance to go up, instead of always being the bottom pariah.

From this point of view, he is still a great benevolent person! In ancient times, it was a sage who had been passed down through the ages!
